title: On the Falling Away of the Synagogue
english: On the falling away of the synagogue, or the renaming of Abram as Abraham.

Of Saint Cyril, from the discourse entitled Demonstration, through the divine oracles spoken from the first to the inspired patriarchs, concerning the exchange and transfer involving the Jews and the nations.
The renaming of Abraham has been found to signify the threefold count of the divine and sovereign persons: for though the inspired patriarch was called Abram, God renamed him Abraham (Genesis 17:5).

english: alpha, a grouping that signifies Father — for ‘aba’ is surely translated father.

title: The Most High and the Holy Spirit
english: he will again discover, in reverse order and gathering in the same rho, a grouping that signifies Most High — for ‘mar’ is plainly translated most high — a title that hints at the person of the all-holy Spirit, since the term teaches us indirectly that he is God by nature and truly exists. For the Most High is by nature nothing else but altogether God by nature.

title: The Trinity Prefigured in the Name
english: clearly outlined beforehand and proclaimed beforehand the most ineffable and most mystical doctrine of the holy Trinity as well. The name of Abraham plainly displaying, signifying, and initiating into the mystery the Father and the Son and the holy Spirit — in agreement with the most manifest naming and numbering and handing down of Christ our Savior in the doctrine of God (Matthew 28:19).
